title: Why do so many AI chatbots call themselves Nova? I asked ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and more to name themselves
summary: I opened the major AI chatbots and asked each one exactly the same question: "I think you should name yourself, what would you like to be called?" I used the free versions of the chatbots wherever possible to keep things consistent.
